summary: Supadio International Airport is the primary gateway to West Kalimantan province, serving the city of Pontianak on the island of Borneo in Indonesia. Named after Supadio, an early Indonesian aviation pioneer, it handles domestic flights connecting to major cities like Jakarta and Surabaya, along with select regional routes. The airport sits remarkably close to the equator, reflecting Pontianak's unique geographic position as one of the few major cities straddling zero degrees latitude.
faqs:
Q: How far is Supadio Airport from Pontianak city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 15-20 km south of the city center, with typical travel times of 30-45 minutes by car depending on traffic conditions.

Q: Does Supadio Airport offer international flights?
A: Yes, it serves a limited number of international destinations, primarily in the region, alongside numerous domestic routes across the Indonesian archipelago.
